decisions.decision: Board members are to submit any further legal services questions in writing to the Town Manager so they can be sent to the firms before the second round of interviews.
decisions.quote: board members submit any further questions in writing to her so they can be sent to the firms and be answered before the second round of interviews.

decisions.decision: Board members are to submit their evaluations of the legal firms to the Town Manager; the Town Manager will call three references listed by the firms plus one community similar in size to Lunenburg.
decisions.quote: the board should submit their evaluations of the legal firms and submit them to ms. lemieux.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will call the three references listed by the firms plus one community similar in size to Lunenburg that is not on their list.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will call the three references listed by the firms plus one community similar in size to lunenburg that they work for

decisions.decision: The Board signed a letter of appreciation for Peggy Stewart, Head Accounting Clerk.

decisions.decision: Ms. Bertram asked for the actual value of each tax title property and the potential legal cost of foreclosure; Mr. Ebersole suggested adding assessed value, square footage/acreage, whether there is a building, and the original date of taking.
decisions.quote: ms. bertram stated she would like to know the actual value of each property and the potential legal cost of going through foreclosure.

decisions.decision: An update on the MS4 permit was requested from the DPW Director for the next agenda.
decisions.quote: an update on the permit was requested from the dpw director on the next agenda.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager will follow up on the warranty and leak questions about the new school's solar panels.
decisions.quote: ms. lemieux will follow up on this.

decisions.decision: Ms. Bertram offered to provide the Town Manager a template she created from notes taken at the strategic planning workshop.
decisions.quote: ms. bertam offered to provide a template she created from notes taken from that workshop meeting to ms. lemieux.

decisions.decision: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant and payroll warrants.
